scope: Independent permutation math, bounded-control construction, and synthetic component isolation; no real checkpoint, hidden state or model prediction was read. Production coverage is a separate generation receipt.

tests.exhaustive_simple_anchor_range: all permutations n4 through8, every i2..n-2

frozen_generation_choices.same_label_search: earlier-only positions1..i-2 first; then full read-prefix1..i+1; each at most64 seeded permutations followed by all lexicographically ordered transpositions; suffixi+2..n/local label/resolved prefix count/total count all exact
frozen_generation_choices.components: original anchor, both directed pairs, every same-label donor and actual recipient-local-only counterfactual, joined under p/Cp equality; whole-component original-training exclusion; test-root components exclude validation families; remaining validation components hash fit/dev
frozen_generation_choices.fit_AB: hash component ID into A/B; root fits/checks only count-matched fit i>=6

mathematics.simple: Ascending L<a<b<R at i-1..i+2; swapping a,b adds exactly peak_i, changes resolved and total peak counts by+1, preserves suffixi+2..n. Reverse direction subtracts1.
mathematics.count_matched: Disjoint earlier quartet centerk2 and locali>=6: recipient earlier-active/local-inactive, donor earlier-inactive/local-active. Peak changes at exactly{k,i} with opposite signs, prefix and total counts unchanged.
mathematics.actual_local_counterfactual: Swap only recipient local middle values; all other peaks stay fixed, local label matches directed donor, resolved and total counts change by intended sign. This endpoint differs from count-matched donor and is included in leakage components.
mathematics.valleys: Complement all complete input permutations; peak_i becomes valley_i with same count/position identities.
mathematics.same_label: Changed prefix with same local label, resolved prefix count and global count; earlier peak locations can differ.
mathematics.read_point: After pi_(i+1); one-line numeric token index4+2*i including BOS/SIZE/n/ONE_START.

limitations: Other raw permutation statistics need not be invariant; in the simple raw input valley_(i+1) can change while only peak_i changes.
Complement isolation does not claim inverse/reversal orbit isolation. Stronger original anchor restrictions must be supplied through root_indices if required.
No neural causal claim follows from this mathematical audit.
Production fit/dev/test quotas can fall short after component exclusion; report actual coverage and never impute missing records.
